Financial Year & Period

Every module opens on the Current Period (Journal Generator Period and Date, Lease Status, Rental AR/AP Output, Trial Balance, Debit/Credit Note export range). It is a default only: any month can still be chosen in each module.

Access Control

Workflow-level gate only — this is a static file with no server, so this cannot stop a technically able user from bypassing it (editing localStorage, dev tools, or the file itself). Its job is to keep casual users on the modules assigned to them. The master account (MPL) always has every permission and cannot be edited here.
